Touhou Bansho Cards

Does Touhou Bansho Cards use AI? Yes. According to the developer's AI disclosure on Steam, AI was used for the art in Touhou Bansho Cards. The game costs $8.09 and runs on Windows.

Listed on GenPlay 25 Oct 2026 · source: Steam

Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Questions about Touhou Bansho Cards

What did AI make in Touhou Bansho Cards?

The developer lists the art. In their own words: “Generative AI was used in the game's art production for image creation and image enhancement. Generative AI was used to translate the game's localized content.”

Is Touhou Bansho Cards free?

Touhou Bansho Cards costs $8.09 on Steam.

Where can I play Touhou Bansho Cards?

On Steam. It runs on Windows.
